scope: 106 existing calibration/regression tasks on 32 repositories; Context at 16000 o200k_base tokens

before.fileSelection: fixed two test files; excerpt-only comparison

after.fileSelection: fixed two test files; excerpt-only comparison

limitations: No independent unseen cohort or general-precision claim. All cases are known calibration data.
Sparse supporting/negative annotations do not measure total noise.
Known private input probe fixes two candidates and compares excerpts only, without claiming a full 25-file retrieval replay or publishing source.
Concurrent single-sample timings are diagnostic and do not establish a performance change.
rangeEncoding: Each fresh baseline matches its canonical baseline source hashes, selections and ranges exactly. rangeChanges replaces only the listed per-path ranges; all other ranges remain those of the canonical baseline. Before/after source hashes and unchanged frozen manifest hashes are verified.

annotationNotes.effect: An annotated blank separator is omitted; raw rangeCoverage and completeContext decrease.
